# XOOTEQ message sheet

## One-liner

An idea that won't let you sleep still needs a place, the hardware and the people to build it. XOOTEQ gives builders workspace, living space, GPU access, dev infrastructure and a table of engineers, filmmakers, researchers and designers, with no pitch decks required, so you can ship something that actually matters.

| Problem | Solution | Result |

## Positioning

| Who it's for | Builders aged 18 to 35 who are making something unconventional: engineers, filmmakers, researchers and designers with an idea that won't let them sleep. |
| In one sentence | XOOTEQ is a technology R&D company that builds software and AI, makes films with artificial intelligence, runs an environmental initiative called the Green Revolution, and brings builders together to make things that matter. |
| In one paragraph | XOOTEQ is a technology R&D company. It builds software and AI systems, explores AI filmmaking through its studio DUMBORD, runs the Green Revolution (planting trees and protecting green spaces in every city it works in, every quarter), and backs builders with workspace, living space, hardware, GPU access, dev infrastructure and a peer network. Every idea, project and person runs through one question: does it matter? Not an agency. Not an accelerator. Builders inviting other builders to the table. |
| Category | Technology R&D company |
| Different from | Not an agency and not an accelerator: no pitch decks, no demo days, no automated rejections. Builders inviting other builders to the table, and direct, physical green action instead of carbon credits. |

## Copy limits by format

Words allowed per part (0 = leave it out).

| Format | Headline | Subhead | Body | CTA | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billboard / large outdoor | 7 | 0 | 0 | 4 | One idea, one image. CTA is a short URL or handle. |
| Poster (A3, A2, 18x24 in) | 10 | 18 | 40 | 6 | Readable from 3 m. Details (date, place, URL) go in small type. |
| Event poster | 8 | 15 | 30 | 6 | Details must include date, time and place. |
| Instagram / LinkedIn post (on-image text) | 8 | 12 | 25 | 5 | The caption is separate; its first line (about 125 characters) shows before 'more'. |
| Instagram / Facebook story, Reel cover | 8 | 10 | 15 | 4 | Keep text out of the top and bottom 250 px (interface overlays). |
| Carousel slide | 10 | 15 | 40 | 5 | First slide is the hook; last slide carries the CTA. |
| YouTube thumbnail | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Three to five big words, maximum. |
| Display banner | 6 | 8 | 0 | 3 | CTA as a button. |
| Website hero section | 10 | 25 | 50 | 4 | Headline: what you offer. Subhead: how life gets better. Button: the next step. |
| Email header and subject | 9 | 15 | 80 | 4 | Subject line under about 50 characters. |
| Flyer (A5, A4) | 12 | 20 | 150 | 8 | Use subheads to break body copy. |
| Long-copy print ad | 16 | 25 | 600 | 10 | Image, headline, body, then logo and CTA. Caption every image. |
